guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the DeepBook Waitlist
guide.description: Go to the DeepBook waitlist page and enter your email address to request early access to the new trading app.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify Your Email
guide.description: Open the confirmation email DeepBook sends and click the verification link to lock in your spot on the list.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Traders to Move Up the Queue
guide.description: Share your referral link with other traders. Each signup through your link moves you higher in the queue, since access opens in waves rather than all at once.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Visit the DeepBook Claims Portal
guide.description: Go to the DeepBook claims portal . Read and accept the terms of use and privacy policy before moving on.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Confirm You Have SUI for Gas
guide.description: Claiming is an on-chain transaction, so your wallet needs a small amount of SUI to cover the network fee. If you need some, you can buy SUI from Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Season 1 Wallet
guide.description: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Click “Connect Wallet” and link the same wallet you used to earn points during Season 1. Approve the connection request in your wallet. If you traded from more than one address, connect each separately to check for allocations.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Review and Submit Your Claim
guide.description: Check the DEEP allocation shown, then submit the claim transaction and approve it in your wallet. Once it confirms, your DEEP appears in the connected wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

risks: 项目尚未确认空投，存在投入后无回报的可能。
真实性置信度偏低，证据不足，建议先观察。
任何要求输入助记词、私钥或恢复短语的页面都不可信。
